measurement: Domain capability score (Cortex scoring.md SC-02, SC-03): how far Sector can trust the Weather Brain's published per-lake weather truth. Not operational health, not production readiness, not a forecast-skill metric, not comparable with any other Brain's score.
question: Per lake, does the Weather Brain publish real measured or official-forecast Sky, Barometric Pressure (with its 3 h trend), Air Temperature and Humidity, and a weather-change signal whose every rule could be evaluated, and has that output passed the validation pre-registered in docs/brains/WEATHER_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5?
scope: Coverage over the directory (/brains/weather.directoryLakeCount). Quality shares over the lakes the Brain supports (/brains/weather.supportedLakeCount: readiness CALIBRATION or DEGRADED) and over their published states (/lakes/{k}/states/weather). Validation fleet-wide.
dimensionClasses: Cortex scoring.md SC-09: CAP bowfishing capability, COV coverage, PRED prediction quality, VAL validation against independent data, ENG engineering completion, VOL research volume. This draft has no ENG or VOL dimension.
unscoredWhen: The registry /brains/weather is absent or has never carried lastSuccessfulRun (the Brain has never published). The scorer then writes NO score block: the Brain is UNSCORED, never 0. Today this holds (the Brain is PARKED, has no live writer run, and run.py --write refuses).

dimensions.label: Pre-registered validation (plan section 5)

scale.absent: UNKNOWN (scores 0, excluded from completeness; the validation gate still fires)

dimensions.note: The Weather publication contract declares /validation/weather; the runtime does not write it yet (only Moon and Generation do). Until it does, this dimension is UNKNOWN. See validationStatusMeaning for what each status must mean.

dimensions.label: Directory lakes with a Weather state
dimensions.note: Lakes outside NWS coverage are BLOCKED (gap WX-004) and stay in the denominator: abstaining is honest but it is not coverage.

dimensions.label: States on a fresh station observation with all four tiles
dimensions.note: Readiness CALIBRATION = state kind 'observation', not stale, and an empty 'missing' list (sector_weather.state.readiness). DEGRADED (stale observation or a missing tile, no estimate put in its place) earns nothing here.

dimensions.label: Weather-change signal with every rule evaluated
dimensions.fact: /lakes/{k}/states/weather.weatherChange.unknown is an empty list, share over published states
dimensions.note: A rule that cannot be evaluated makes the lake WATCH (owner decision 2026-11-22), so a high WATCH share measures data gaps, not weather. This dimension credits states whose signal rests on complete inputs. It says nothing about whether the signal is right (that is validation, plan 5.3).

dimensions.label: Barometric 3 h trend published
dimensions.fact: /lakes/{k}/states/weather.pressure.trend3h is non-null, share over published states
dimensions.note: The trend is the tile's bowfishing meaning (rising / falling / steady) and an input to the change signal. A pressure FORECAST is not credited anywhere: none exists (gap WX-003), and a permanently empty dimension is not added (scoring.md SC-09).

gates.tiesTo: the Brain's own run outcome (lastRunOutcome FAILED writes health FAILED)
the same coverage gate as lake-brain-score-v1
WEATHER_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5: the change-signal check (5.3, 60 days) or the representativeness check (5.2, 30 days) has not passed yet

validationStatusMeaning.source: docs/brains/WEATHER_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5, pre-registered 2026-11-22 before any data. Thresholds are not restated here; they are the plan's, and a failed criterion is reported, never tuned away.
validationStatusMeaning.VALIDATED: 5.1 fidelity PASS (14 days), 5.2 representativeness PASS on its 30-day window with the minimum sample met (500 pairs, 20 lakes), and 5.3 change signal PASS for both RAIN_ONSET and FRONT_PASSAGE on its 60-day window.
validationStatusMeaning.PARTIAL: 5.1 fidelity PASS and at least one of 5.2 or 5.3 scored PASS; the other not yet scored, INSUFFICIENT, or FAILED.
validationStatusMeaning.NOT_VALIDATED: Anything else, including 5.1 FAILED (a published value that does not match its station is the one failure this Brain may not have) and any INSUFFICIENT sample. INSUFFICIENT is never PASS.
validationStatusMeaning.whoSetsIt: The Weather Brain's validation record (a reviewed change that writes /validation/weather), never the scorer and never Ops.

the pre-registered validation scored and PASSED (lifts the 5.0 and 7.0 caps)
cannotCount: the package, contracts, tests or the Brain Cert Kit (engineering, not capability)
an unapproved thresholds release, or WATCH lakes as if they were evaluated
values from the forecast grid presented as observations
